verdict.rationale: Datadog's integrations page claims you can track code changes and deployments alongside application performance in real time through GitHub and GitLab integrations. Community feedback credits its tag-based correlation across APM, metrics and logs, which supports linking regressions to deploys. However, the pack contains only that single marketing-level claim: there is no first-party documentation of deployment or version tracking in APM, and nothing showing configuration-change tracking. missing for 10: detailed docs on deploy/version markers tied to regressions, configuration-change tracking evidence, hands-on corroboration of deploy-regression correlation.
